claims.head: Pittsburgh lets teams in close, and Dallas goes there
claims.body: Pittsburgh has struggled to keep shots to the perimeter (23rd of 32), and Dallas makes its shots count: one expected goal for every 14.9 unblocked shots, 4th in the league.

claims.head: Pittsburgh plays fast; Dallas slows it down
